folder-pane-plus.label: 新增浏览窗格
folder-pane-plus.note: 窗格分隔与加号，区别于新建文件夹

grid.label: 网格视图
grid.body: <rect x="3" y="3" width="5" height="5" rx="0.6" /><rect x="12" y="3" width="5" height="5" rx="0.6" /><rect x="3" y="12" width="5" height="5" rx="0.6" /><rect x="12" y="12" width="5" height="5" rx="0.6" />

smooth-display.label: 平滑显示
smooth-display.note: 图像框内的连续平顺曲线

image-resize.label: 图像操作／调整尺寸
image-resize.note: 图像轮廓与向外扩展箭头

compare.label: 比较所选图像
compare.note: 错位的两幅图像与比较箭头

settings.label: 设置
settings.body: <path d="M3 5h4 M11 5h6 M3 10h8 M15 10h2 M3 15h2 M9 15h8" /><rect x="7" y="3" width="4" height="4" rx="0.7" /><rect x="11" y="8" width="4" height="4" rx="0.7" /><rect x="5" y="13" width="4" height="4" rx="0.7" />

split-vertical.label: 垂直分割
split-vertical.body: <rect x="2.5" y="4" width="15" height="12" rx="0.8" /><path d="M10 2.5v15 M4.5 12l3-4 M12.5 12l3-4" /><rect x="8.5" y="8.5" width="3" height="3" rx="0.5" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/>
split-vertical.note: 同一画面内的可拖动分割线

cover.label: 按住查看候选图 B
cover.note: 前置候选图，图内 B 与快捷键一致

fit.label: 适应窗口
fit.body: <path d="M7 3H3v4 M13 3h4v4 M3 13v4h4 M13 17h4v-4" /><rect x="6.5" y="7" width="7" height="6" rx="0.6" />
fit.note: 完整图像置于视口边界内

actual-size.label: 实际像素 1:1
actual-size.body: <path d="M3 7l2-1v8 M13 7l2-1v8" /><circle cx="9.5" cy="8" r="0.65" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/><circle cx="9.5" cy="12" r="0.65" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/>
actual-size.note: 直接绘制 1:1，避免眼睛图标歧义

rotate-ccw-square.label: 逆时针旋转 90°
rotate-ccw-square.body: <g transform="translate(20 0) scale(-1 1)"><path d="M4 7a6.2 6.2 0 0 1 11-2 M15 1.8v3.7h-3.7" /><rect x="6" y="9" width="8" height="8" rx="0.7" /></g>

info.label: 图像信息
info.body: <rect x="3" y="3" width="14" height="14" rx="2" /><path d="M9 9h1.5v5 M8.5 14h4" /><circle cx="10" cy="6.5" r="0.75" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/>
info.note: 信息 i，替代警告感叹号

exif.label: EXIF 拍摄参数
exif.note: 相机与参数行，替代拼写检查符号

histogram.label: 亮度直方图
histogram.note: 连续分布轮廓，区别于普通柱状统计

pixel-probe.label: 像素取值
pixel-probe.body: <path d="M7 3H3v4 M13 3h4v4 M3 13v4h4 M13 17h4v-4" /><rect x="7" y="7" width="6" height="6" rx="0" /><rect x="9" y="9" width="2" height="2" rx="0" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/>

thumbnail-preview.label: 导航缩略图
thumbnail-preview.body: <rect x="2.5" y="3.5" width="15" height="13" rx="1" /><path d="M4.5 13l4-5 3 3 2-2 2 4" /><rect x="10.5" y="5.5" width="5" height="4" rx="0.4" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity=".14"/>
thumbnail-preview.note: 整图中的小视口，替代准星

screenshot.label: 保存比较截图
screenshot.note: 相机外形与保存箭头，区别于裁剪
